# Al-Noor Quran Academy

> Al-Noor Quran Academy is an accredited global online Islamic educational institution delivering structured 1-on-1 private Quran recitation, Tajweed, Noorani Qaida, Hifz-ul-Quran (memorization), and Islamic Studies classes for kids, adults, and slow learners across the UK, USA, Canada, Australia, UAE, and Pakistan.

## Academy Overview
- **Institution**: Al-Noor Quran Academy
- **Website**: [Al-Noor Quran Academy Home](https://www.alnoorquranacademy.com)
- **WhatsApp Support**: [Direct WhatsApp Chat](https://wa.me/923274496163)

- **Free Trial**: [Book 3-Day Free Trial](https://www.alnoorquranacademy.com/free-trial)
- **Tutor Roster**: 30+ Certified Male and Female Alim/Qari/Hafiz instructors
- **Class Format**: 1-on-1 Live Interactive Sessions via Zoom/Google Meet
- **Languages of Instruction**: English, Urdu, Arabic

## Core Learning Programs
- [Noorani Qaida for Beginners](https://www.alnoorquranacademy.com/noorani-qaida): Arabic alphabet phonetics, articulation points (Makharij), and Harakaat.
- [Nazra Quran with Tajweed](https://www.alnoorquranacademy.com/quran-reading-nazra): Fluent reading of the 30 Juz with proper rules of Noon Sakinah, Meem Sakinah, and Madd.
- [Quran Recitation & Tajweed Rules](https://www.alnoorquranacademy.com/quran-with-tajweed): Intensive phonetic mastery, Waqf stop signs, and classical vocal cadence.
- [Hifz-ul-Quran Memorization](https://www.alnoorquranacademy.com/quran-memorization-hifz): Structured Sabaq (new lesson), Sabqi (recent revision), and Manzil (cumulative retention).
- [Islamic Studies & Duas](https://www.alnoorquranacademy.com/islamic-studies): Daily supplications, 6 Kalimahs, Salah prayers, and moral manners.
- [Female Quran Tutors](https://www.alnoorquranacademy.com/female-quran-teacher): Dedicated certified female scholars for sisters, daughters, and young girls.
